e.title: NOLHGA（美国保险保障体系）：破产保险公司名单与保障体系成本
e.title_en: NOLHGA (the US guaranty system): lists of insolvent insurers and the costs of the guaranty system
e.title_hk: NOLHGA（美國保險保障體系）：破產保險公司名單與保障體系成本
e.summary: 美国寿险与健康险保障协会全国组织：公开破产保险公司名单、破产成本、保障体系报告、按州保障协会法律与分摊能力资料，是保险破产与保单持有人保障的一手数据层
e.summary_en: The national organisation of US life and health insurance guaranty associations: it publishes lists of insolvent insurers, insolvency costs, guaranty-system reports, state guaranty association laws and assessment-capacity material — a primary data layer on insurance insolvency and policyholder protection
e.summary_hk: 美國壽險與健康險保障協會全國組織：公開破產保險公司名單、破產成本、保障體系報告、按州保障協會法律與分攤能力資料，是保險破產與保單持有人保障的一手數據層
e.body:
**NOLHGA（National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations）** 是**美国各州寿险与健康险保障协会的全国性协调组织**，其作用是当一家会员保险公司破产时，由**各州保障协会接手保单、继续给付**。本条目补的是**「保单持有人保障 / 保险破产」这一形态**：**实测池内该形态成员为 0**——池内最接近的是 **[[pbgc]]，但那是养老金给付保证（美国 ERISA 体系下的养老金保险）**，**对象是养老金而非保单**；另有 **[[hkmc]]**，其条目内容是**公共年金、逆按揭与按揭保险统计**，**并不覆盖保单持有人保障计划**（**这一点本词条特别注明，以免读者误以为香港的保障计划已被收录**）。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页标题实测为 **「Home - NOLHGA」**；⭐ **「Insolvent Insurance Companies（破产保险公司）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/`，实测 230.2KB**——**体量为全站最大的数据页之一**；⭐ **「Insolvency Costs（破产成本）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/`，实测 181.1KB**；**「Guaranty System Reports（保障体系报告）」页 `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/`，实测 126.1KB**；导航实测另含 **`/the-guaranty-system/assessments-capacity/`（分摊与能力）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-association-laws/`（各州保障协会法律）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/nolhga-journal/`（NOLHGA Journal 期刊）**、**`/the-guaranty-system/overview-the-guaranty-system/`**、**`/policyholders/insolvent-insurance-companies/`**、**`/policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association/`（按州找到对应保障协会）**、**`/assessable-premium-exhibit-resources-2/`（可分摊保费明细资料）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「保险破产」这一风险维度的数据层**——池内风险侧此前**极密**（准备金、巨灾、死亡率、网络风险各数十条），但**「保险公司自己倒闭」这一风险几乎无人覆盖**；**对做保险公司偿付能力与市场退出分析的学生，这是唯一一类「真实破产案例 + 真实保障成本」的公开数据**（可与 [[run-off-tracker]] 的退出/清盘追踪、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[insurance-governance]] 并读——**前者是模型算资本，这一条是资本不够时实际发生了什么**）。**② 与 [[pbgc]] 构成「同一逻辑、两个对象」的清晰对照**——**两者都是「给付保证」机制：PBGC 保证养老金给付，NOLHGA 体系保证保单给付**；把两条并读，学生可以一次看清**保障型金融机制的通用结构（会员分摊 + 触发条件 + 给付上限 + 接管机构）**。**③ 「各州保障协会法律」与「分摊能力」两栏对研究监管结构的学生有独特价值**——**美国保险保障是州级而非联邦级**，这与 [[naic-financial-data-repository]] 的州级监管体系一致，**是「分散监管」的一个具体成本与协调机制的样本**（可与 [[iais-icp]] 的国际原则层、[[a2ii]] 的监管能力建设并读）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**页面存在、标题、页面体量与导航结构**，**但未打开破产公司名单的具体内容、未打开成本数据、未下载任何报告或期刊**，因此**不能转述任何一家破产公司名称、成本金额、年份或分摊规则**；**② 「破产保险公司名单」页体量 230.2KB 是实测值**，**但其中有多少是实际名单、有多少是页面框架与导航，本次未区分**；**③ 「保障上限、触发条件、分摊公式」本次全部未核实**——**这些都在保障体系的法律与规则文件中，本词条不转述**；**④ 该组织与各州保障协会的权责分工、以及其与 NAIC 的关系本次未核实**；**⑤** 本词条**不主张** NOLHGA 提供逐家保险公司的财务数据或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页、`/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/`（230.2KB）、`/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/`（181.1KB）、`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/`（126.1KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并读取标题与导航；**未打开名单内容、成本数据、报告或期刊**。
e.body_en:
**NOLHGA (the National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations)** is **the national coordinating body of the US state life and health insurance guaranty associations**; when a member insurer fails, the **state guaranty associations take over the policies and continue paying benefits**. This entry adds the **"policyholder protection and insurance insolvency"** form: **a measured count found zero members of this form** — the closest item, **[[pbgc]], is pension benefit insurance (the US ERISA pension guaranty system)**, **covering pensions rather than policies**; and **[[hkmc]]**’s entry covers **public annuities, reverse mortgages and mortgage insurance statistics, not a policyholder protection scheme** (**flagged explicitly here so readers do not assume Hong Kong’s scheme is already covered**).

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Home - NOLHGA"**; ⭐ the **"Insolvent Insurance Companies" page `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/` measures 230.2KB** — **among the largest data pages on the site**; ⭐ the **"Insolvency Costs" page `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/` measures 181.1KB**; the **"Guaranty System Reports" page `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/` measures 126.1KB**; measured navigation also includes **`/the-guaranty-system/assessments-capacity/`**, **`/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-association-laws/`**, **`/the-guaranty-system/nolhga-journal/` (the NOLHGA Journal)**, **`/the-guaranty-system/overview-the-guaranty-system/`**, **`/policyholders/insolvent-insurance-companies/`**, **`/policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association/`** and **`/assessable-premium-exhibit-resources-2/`**.

For RIAA: **① it adds a data layer for the "insurance insolvency" risk dimension** — the corpus’s risk side is **very dense** (dozens of entries each on reserving, catastrophe, mortality and cyber risk), yet **"an insurer going bust itself" is barely covered**; **for students analysing insurer solvency and market exit, this is the only class of public data offering "real insolvency cases plus real guaranty costs"** (readable with [[run-off-tracker]]’s exit and run-off tracking, [[ggsolvencyii]], [[insurance-mrm]] and [[insurance-governance]] — **the others model capital; this shows what actually happens when capital runs out**). **② With [[pbgc]] it forms a clean "same logic, two objects" contrast** — **both are benefit-guaranty mechanisms: PBGC guarantees pension benefits, the NOLHGA system guarantees policy benefits**; read together they reveal **the generic structure of a guarantee mechanism (member assessments, trigger conditions, benefit caps, a taking-over institution)**. **③ The "guaranty association laws" and "assessments capacity" sections are unusually valuable for studying regulatory structure** — **US insurance guaranty is state-level rather than federal**, consistent with the state-based supervision behind [[naic-financial-data-repository]], and **a concrete sample of the costs and coordination mechanisms of fragmented supervision** (readable with the international-principles layer of [[iais-icp]] and the supervisory-capacity work of [[a2ii]]).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **page existence, titles, page sizes and navigation structure**, **but opened none of the insolvent-company list contents, none of the cost data, and downloaded no report or journal**, so **no insolvent company name, cost figure, year or assessment rule can be restated**; **② the 230.2KB size of the insolvency list page is a measured value**, **but how much of it is actual list content versus page frame and navigation was not distinguished**; **③ benefit caps, trigger conditions and assessment formulas were entirely unverified** — **they live in the scheme’s legal and rule documents and are not restated here**; **④ the division of responsibilities between this organisation and the state guaranty associations, and its relationship to the NAIC, were not verified**; **⑤** this entry **does not claim NOLHGA provides firm-level financial data or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage, `/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/` (230.2KB), `/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/` (181.1KB) and `/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/` (126.1KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with titles and navigation read; **no list content, cost data, report or journal was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**NOLHGA（National Organization of Life & Health Insurance Guaranty Associations）** 是**美國各州壽險與健康險保障協會的全國性協調組織**；當會員保險公司破產時，由**各州保障協會接手保單、繼續給付**。本條目補的是**「保單持有人保障／保險破產」這一形態**：**實測池內該形態成員為 0**——最接近的是 **[[pbgc]]，但那是養老金給付保證**，**對象是養老金而非保單**；另有 **[[hkmc]]**，其內容是**公共年金、逆按揭與按揭保險統計**，**並不覆蓋保單持有人保障計劃**（**本詞條特別註明，以免讀者誤以為香港的保障計劃已被收錄**）。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home - NOLHGA」**；⭐ **「Insolvent Insurance Companies」頁實測 230.2KB**；⭐ **「Insolvency Costs」頁實測 181.1KB**；**「Guaranty System Reports」頁實測 126.1KB**；導航另含 **assessments-capacity（分攤與能力）**、**guaranty-association-laws（各州保障協會法律）**、**NOLHGA Journal 期刊**、**policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association（按州找到對應保障協會）**、**assessable-premium-exhibit-resources**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「保險破產」這一風險維度的數據層**——池內風險側此前**極密**（準備金、巨災、死亡率、網絡風險各數十條），但**「保險公司自己倒閉」幾乎無人覆蓋**；**對做償付能力與市場退出分析的學生，這是唯一一類「真實破產案例 + 真實保障成本」的公開數據**（可與 [[run-off-tracker]]、[[ggsolvencyii]]、[[insurance-mrm]]、[[insurance-governance]] 並讀——**前者是模型算資本，這一條是資本不夠時實際發生了什麼**）。**② 與 [[pbgc]] 構成「同一邏輯、兩個對象」的清晰對照**——**PBGC 保證養老金給付，NOLHGA 體系保證保單給付**；並讀可一次看清**保障型金融機制的通用結構（會員分攤 + 觸發條件 + 給付上限 + 接管機構）**。**③ 「各州保障協會法律」與「分攤能力」對研究監管結構有獨特價值**——**美國保險保障是州級而非聯邦級**，**是「分散監管」的一個具體成本與協調機制樣本**（可與 [[naic-financial-data-repository]]、[[iais-icp]]、[[a2ii]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**頁面存在、標題、體量與導航結構**，**但未打開破產公司名單內容、未打開成本數據、未下載任何報告或期刊**，故**不能轉述任何破產公司名稱、成本金額、年份或分攤規則**；**② 230.2KB 為實測值**，**但其中多少是實際名單、多少是頁面框架，本次未區分**；**③ 保障上限、觸發條件、分攤公式本次全部未核實**——**本詞條不轉述**；**④ 該組織與各州保障協會的權責分工、以及與 NAIC 的關係未核實**；**⑤** 本詞條**不主張** NOLHGA 提供逐家保險公司財務數據或精算工具**。**核實說明**：四個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並讀取標題與導航；**未打開名單內容、成本數據、報告或期刊**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页标题「Home - NOLHGA」；⭐/the-guaranty-system/insolvent-insurance-companies/ 230.2KB 标题「Insolvent Insurance Companies - NOLHGA」；⭐/the-guaranty-system/insolvency-costs/ 181.1KB 标题「Insolvency Costs - NOLHGA」；/the-guaranty-system/guaranty-system-reports/ 126.1KB 标题「Guaranty System Reports - NOLHGA」；导航实测含 assessments-capacity、guaranty-association-laws、nolhga-journal、policyholders/contact-my-guaranty-association、assessable-premium-exhibit-resources-2）+ ★池内「保单持有人保障/保险破产」形态成员 0（pbgc 是养老金给付保证、对象不同；hkmc 条目内容是公共年金与逆按揭，不覆盖保单持有人保障计划——已在词条内注明）；未打开名单内容、成本数据、报告或期刊、未核实保障上限与分摊规则
